source_of_truth: one owner-supplied release_target plus append-only repository identity refs and trusted preparation provenance
numeric_baseline: highest eligible final remote product tag vX.Y.Z

version_policy.trusted_baseline: highest eligible final product tag reachable from main
version_policy.ordering: repository compare_versions with final above prerelease
version_policy.collision: reject product tag or identity-ref ownership before preparation
version_policy.recovery: same merge SHA, canonical version, channel, policy, reservation, and artifact digests

target_gate.source: trusted main checkout plus preparation trailers

completion.source: current PR head/base plus preparation trailers after exact match

preparation.descendant_retry: reuse exact same-PR claim when reservation source is an ancestor of the current source

identity_refs.application_enforcement: release_reservation.py enforces append-only create semantics, same-claim idempotency, provenance, and state order for release and artifact receipts; out-of-band deletion of excluded identity refs is outside application observability
identity_refs.product_tag_provenance: product annotated tags remain created by github-actions[bot]

recovery.same_sha_identity: bound merge SHA + VERSION + channel + matching reservation

artifact_reuse.source: matching finalized artifact receipt and unexpired receipt-named release-assets artifact from one trusted Release Product run; pending receipts prove the pre-artifact repair boundary
artifact_reuse.missing_artifact: fail-closed after a finalized or expired receipt-named release-assets artifact is recorded; a verified pending receipt with no release-assets artifact may rebuild before artifact finalization
artifact_reuse.pre_artifact_repair: same identity, no prior release-assets artifact, rebuild native packages and assemble once
artifact_reuse.verification: durable artifact receipt, exact source run/artifact metadata, archive digest, release manifest, checksum, source SHA, and packaging policy SHA
artifact_reuse.policy_identity: preserve original packaging SHA and record current recovery execution SHA separately

recovery.version_only_release_pr: new non-empty VERSION-only PR with new merge identity
recovery.unresolved_identity: no version, tag, or recovery instruction

release_sequence.source: remote product tags and existing reservation/receipt refs
release_sequence.prerelease_ordinal: explicit owner-provided ordinal; never allocated by recovery
release_sequence.equal_candidate: require tag target equals merge SHA

intent_snapshot.artifact_policy: snapshot-only; immutable refs and trailers remain authoritative
intent_snapshot.notifier_acceptance: artifact run_id and run_attempt must match the failed Release Product workflow run

helper_bootstrap.bootstrap_requires: workflow_dispatch recover with helper_mode=bootstrap and no approved helper Release
